plugin.name: Files
plugin.description: Browse authorized folders and edit text files.
reason.tooLarge: This file is too large to edit here (limit 2 MB).
reason.notText: This file is not UTF-8 text, so it cannot be edited here.
reason.denied: This file is outside the folders you authorized.
folders.addNote: Run “Add folder” to choose a folder on this Mac. Files in it can then be browsed, edited and imported.
folders.note: Rename only changes the name shown here. Removing the authorization does not delete any resource or file; imported records stay, but their files can no longer be opened here.
confirm.delete: Delete permanently? This cannot be undone and the item will not go to the Trash.
folder.note: A folder. Use the actions above to create, rename, move, copy, delete, search or import.
info.name: Item
error.outside: This is outside the folders you authorized.
error.badName: Give a name without “/”, not empty and not “.” or “..”.
error.noDestination: Give the destination folder (an absolute path).
error.destNotFolder: The destination is not a folder.
error.sameFile: The source and the destination are the same.
error.intoItself: A folder cannot go into itself.
error.isRoot: An authorized folder itself cannot be deleted here; remove its authorization instead.
error.noQuery: Give the words to search for.
error.tooMany: Too many files to register (limit {max}). Import a smaller folder.
grant.removed: Authorization removed for {path}. Resources and files were not touched.
import.done: {files} files read: {created} new, {updated} updated, {restored} restored, {missing} missing.
search.partial: {count} found (stopped early: too many files or too deep)
col.name: Name
conflict.exists: “{name}” already exists there. Choose Overwrite, Skip or Keep both under “If the name exists” and run again.
